THE SPINE
The child sees five verbs. The nine stages sit behind them.
Gold, because innovation belongs to the company and crosses all three majalis.

NOTICE
The two exercises the paper pilot rests on. If these do not produce real
problems in one class, nothing further matters. Both work with no code.

THE RECORD, AND WHERE PROBLEMS COME FROM
Every child keeps a passport whether or not they are ever selected.
Problems arrive from us, from the community, or from the child.

Note the tag on each problem: BUILD IT or PROPOSE IT.
That is the two-engine split made visible, so no child reaches
the last gate and finds there was no experiment available.
